tracker.body:
## Problem

Deliver v0.5.0 through qualified alphas and release candidates, starting from v0.4.0 (`5f81cc2563d231501952104e991d858e670325ac`).

## Scope

[Alpha.1](https://github.com/den-run-ai/pystachy/releases/tag/v0.5.0-alpha.1) at `a73c56c92f3aad4b490307a5d1b882e487a57f55` and [alpha.2](https://github.com/den-run-ai/pystachy/releases/tag/v0.5.0-alpha.2) at `80490143498d149d407343ba1cb7aedb1db2d2c5` are published and verified.

Alpha.1: #1470, #1440, #1443, #1293, #1278, #1386, #1387, #1410, #1428, #1429, #1339; repair #1492.

Alpha.2 via #1488: #1277, #1415, #1280, #1281, #1282, #1298, #1274, #1377.

Continue alpha.3 values/numeric protocols; alpha.4 library workflows; alpha.5 final integration/performance; RC.1, further RCs for fixes, then stable. The [PR disposition inventory](https://github.com/den-run-ai/pystachy/blob/3790f5ac4ca4ee660bf747bfc062b22b53d5d897/research/v0.5.0-alpha-qualification/dispositions/README.md) records historical scope decisions; the [completed publication/closure addendum](https://github.com/den-run-ai/pystachy/blob/b4617f31ff75c7611ba9d3f73bc79d047ca4bdd6/research/v0.5.0-alpha-qualification/post-storage/alpha2-publication/publication-closure-addendum.md) updates outcomes.

Async, full native mypy, broad concurrency, libuv/process-worker research, collector experiments and native-wheel prototypes remain outside committed scope.

Prepared with ChatGPT assistance. Publication is authorized; no gate bypasses.

## Done when

Each published version has reviewed source, explained IR/diagnostic changes, full Lean/proof coverage, successful exact-main CI/Installation/Lint/Packages/Performance/Coverage/Variants, full Linux x86/ARM verification and verified native/Docker/PyPI artifacts.

Preserve the 19-row PR budget and 15-minute job cap. Record source SHAs, artifact/run links, exclusions, incomplete verification and #1303 compatibility/build-cost comparisons, with no unexplained new failures or proof-coverage losses. Refs #5, #1322.

[Alpha.1 publication evidence](https://github.com/den-run-ai/pystachy/tree/5b3b50dbdffd873346bf2b3ec9c0aded233f1912/research/v0.5.0-alpha-qualification/post-storage/alpha1-publication). [Alpha.2 final publication, verification and closure evidence](https://github.com/den-run-ai/pystachy/tree/b4617f31ff75c7611ba9d3f73bc79d047ca4bdd6/research/v0.5.0-alpha-qualification/post-storage/alpha2-publication).

Alpha.2 [native Release #67](https://github.com/den-run-ai/pystachy/actions/runs/43626857296) and [PyPI Release #68](https://github.com/den-run-ai/pystachy/actions/runs/43630294045) passed. All 11 public GitHub assets, both Docker configurations and all 11 distinct public blobs/14 references match tested payloads. Public PyPI wheel/sdist bytes match tested packages and exact release Git source files. Fresh isolated public-wheel pip/uv installations passed.

[Complete Lean evidence](https://github.com/den-run-ai/pystachy/tree/f05236f58a51013c49aba6b06963e18edf8f2847/research/v0.5.0-alpha-qualification/post-storage/alpha2-full): 2,550 programs, 1,203 additional proved obligations, no missing cases/newly unproved results/coverage loss; strict storage 18,582/18,582 across 175 programs.

[Exact-main gates and cost evidence](https://github.com/den-run-ai/pystachy/tree/7e37d27bbda6d257e1b2984d679eba885e2db7ca/research/v0.5.0-alpha-qualification/post-storage/alpha2-main): all seven workflows passed, 131 successful jobs plus one expected skip; 58/58 checks across 35 groups per architecture. CI/release jobs stayed under 15 minutes; the 19-row PR budget is preserved. Performance has 49 `ok` comparisons. Bounded warm-build measurements show lower compile time/peak RSS with larger executables; runtime changes are mixed. One bootstrap pair was +4.4%, without confirmation.

Two independent source reviews completed without actionable findings. Four GitHub Codex attempts and local CLI attempts did not complete and are not counted as reviews. The sole historical bot thread is resolved.

The [180-PR disposition snapshot](https://github.com/den-run-ai/pystachy/tree/3790f5ac4ca4ee660bf747bfc062b22b53d5d897/research/v0.5.0-alpha-qualification/dispositions) remains unchanged. The [completed addendum](https://github.com/den-run-ai/pystachy/blob/b4617f31ff75c7611ba9d3f73bc79d047ca4bdd6/research/v0.5.0-alpha-qualification/post-storage/alpha2-publication/publication-closure-addendum.md) records publication and closure of #1415, #1281 and #1282 after unchanged complete-head ancestry checks.

Final public checks confirm GitHub stable v0.4.0, PyPI default 0.4.0 and Docker latest unchanged. No scheduled monitoring or automations were created. Alpha.3–5, RCs and stable remain future work; this issue stays open.
